registry_changes: Set version to canary-13a2. All other changes are confined to the partner predicate; other predicates, shared language, call groups, kinds and uses rules are unchanged.
Added timeline and bridges to partner. Retained recorded, linked and attributes, satisfying the declared dependencies.
Changed exclusive to false so explicit overlapping relationships do not assert an at-most-one-current invariant or enable stated_unique merely from one known holder.

Retained succession=true and slot=null: one unsplit romantic-history track, with succession subject to the documented trusted-text, sole-open-fact and already-ended safeguards. Relationship labels do not create separate tracks.
Set gap_months=12. Before/after queries across gaps longer than twelve months must explain the gap instead of naming a partner; the fixtures encode that outcome as an empty answer_person.
Expanded English and Spanish query cues for dating, dated, seeing, going out with, spouse, ex, saliendo con, salía con, salir con and related relationship terms.

Clarified the extraction definition to cover only the user's romantic relationships, preserve denials, overlaps, separate reunion episodes and stated temporal evidence, and avoid dating an undated breakup from the memory's written date.
Retained role lexicon, former ex cue, label qualifier and answer phrases. Added no undocumented template fields or new sentence-pattern mechanism.

The app specification says declared uses require a qualification record before activation. This registry declares the capability; the blind fixtures are proposed qualification evidence, not a claim that the frozen implementation has passed or that qualification is already enabled.

stories.title: Three successive partners at mixed date precision

memories.text: Leo is my ex. We dated from 2017 until January 2019.
I went hiking with my girlfriend Mira. We started dating in March 2019.
Mira and I broke up in December 2020. I kept the hiking maps.
Jordan is my boyfriend; we started dating in 2021.
Jordan is still my boyfriend. We booked the coastal train.

memories.text: Ari is my boyfriend. We began dating in February 2013.
Ari and I broke up. I don't want to put a date on it in this note.
I brought my boyfriend Ben to dinner. We started dating in January 2016.
Ben and I ended our relationship in June 2018.
I found the old calendar: Ari and I broke up in October 2015.
I got back with my ex Ari in August 2020. We are still together. I had been single since the breakup with Ben.
